title: Long exact Ext sequence in the first variable
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $Y$ an $R$-module, and $0\to X'\xrightarrow{u}X\xrightarrow{v}X''\to0$ a short exact sequence of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. With $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(-,Y)$ as in [def-pc-ext], there are connecting homomorphisms $\delta^i:\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(X',Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{i+1}_R(X'',Y)$ such that $$0\to\operatorname{Hom}_R(X'',Y)\xrightarrow{v^*}\operatorname{Hom}_R(X,Y)\xrightarrow{u^*}\operatorname{Hom}_R(X',Y)\xrightarrow{\delta^0}\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(X'',Y)\xrightarrow{v^*}\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(X,Y)\xrightarrow{u^*}\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(X',Y)\xrightarrow{\delta^1}\operatorname{Ext}^2_R(X'',Y)\to\cdots$$ is exact. Here $u^*$ and $v^*$ are precomposition with $u$ and $v$; in particular, for each $i\ge0$, $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(X,Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(X',Y)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{i+1}_R(X'',Y)$ is exact at its middle group.
